Step:  
1566 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Start: 1566-09-29.  
Back 29 days → 1566-08-31.  
Back further: 121 total days = 29 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 121.  
So:  
Back 29 days to Aug 31,  
back 31 more days to Jul 31,  
back 30 more days to Jul 1,  
back 31 more days to May 31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1566-05-31
